<documents>
<document id="support-financial-abuse">
IfˆsomeoneˆisˆcontrollingˆyourˆmoneyˆIfˆsomeoneˆisˆcontrollingˆyourˆmoney,ˆpressuringˆyouˆtoˆhandˆitˆover,ˆorˆusingˆyourˆaccountˆwithoutˆyourˆpermission,ˆyou'reˆnotˆalone,ˆandˆweˆcanˆhelp.ˆ##ˆTellˆusˆsafelyˆMessageˆsupportˆinˆtheˆappˆwhenˆit'sˆsafe.ˆYouˆcanˆuseˆaˆcodeˆphraseˆlikeˆ"Iˆneedˆtoˆtalkˆaboutˆmyˆaccountˆsecurity"ˆifˆsomeoneˆmightˆseeˆyourˆscreen.ˆSupportˆwillˆpassˆyourˆcaseˆtoˆourˆAccountˆServicesˆteam,ˆwhoˆareˆtrainedˆtoˆhelp.ˆ##ˆWhatˆweˆcanˆdoˆ-ˆChangeˆyourˆpasswordˆandˆsignˆoutˆotherˆdevicesˆ-ˆFreezeˆorˆreplaceˆyourˆcardˆ-ˆStopˆsendingˆpaperˆmailˆtoˆyourˆaddressˆ-ˆTalkˆaboutˆoptionsˆforˆmovingˆmoneyˆyouˆneedˆtoˆkeepˆsafeˆ##ˆWhatˆweˆwon'tˆdoˆWeˆwon'tˆtellˆanyoneˆelseˆyouˆcontactedˆus.ˆ##ˆIfˆyou'reˆinˆdangerˆIfˆyou'reˆinˆimmediateˆdanger,ˆcallˆemergencyˆservicesˆfirst.ˆAccountˆServicesˆrepliesˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdays,ˆandˆfasterˆwhenˆyouˆtellˆusˆit'sˆurgent.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="products-under-18">
Accountsˆforˆunder-18sˆTallowbrookˆaccountsˆareˆforˆpeopleˆagedˆ18ˆandˆover.ˆWeˆdon'tˆofferˆteenˆaccounts,ˆcustodialˆaccountsˆorˆaccountsˆforˆchildren.ˆ##ˆSendingˆmoneyˆtoˆaˆyoungˆpersonˆIfˆyourˆchildˆhasˆanˆaccountˆatˆanotherˆbank,ˆyouˆcanˆsendˆmoneyˆthereˆbyˆACH.ˆ##ˆAddingˆaˆchildˆtoˆyourˆaccountˆYouˆcan'tˆaddˆaˆchildˆasˆanˆauthorizedˆuserˆorˆgiveˆthemˆaˆcardˆonˆyourˆaccount.ˆ##ˆWhenˆtheyˆturnˆ18ˆTheyˆcanˆapplyˆforˆtheirˆownˆaccountˆinˆtheˆappˆwithˆtheirˆownˆIDˆandˆSocialˆSecurityˆnumberˆorˆITIN.ˆ##ˆUsingˆaˆparent'sˆaccountˆPleaseˆdon'tˆletˆsomeoneˆelseˆuseˆyourˆcardˆorˆapp.ˆTransactionsˆmadeˆbyˆsomeoneˆyouˆgaveˆyourˆcardˆtoˆaren'tˆcoveredˆasˆunauthorized.ˆ##ˆStudentsˆStudentsˆagedˆ18ˆandˆoverˆcanˆopenˆanˆaccountˆlikeˆanyoneˆelse.ˆ##ˆGiftsˆforˆaˆchildˆWeˆcan'tˆholdˆmoneyˆonˆaˆchild'sˆbehalf.ˆIfˆyouˆwantˆtoˆsaveˆforˆaˆchild,ˆyouˆcanˆcreateˆaˆSavingsˆPocketˆinˆyourˆownˆaccountˆandˆnameˆitˆafterˆthem.ˆTheˆmoneyˆstaysˆyours.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="support-third-parties">
Canˆsomeoneˆelseˆmanageˆmyˆaccount?ˆTallowbrookˆaccountsˆbelongˆtoˆoneˆperson.ˆWeˆdon'tˆofferˆjointˆaccountsˆorˆauthorizedˆusers,ˆandˆsupportˆonlyˆactsˆforˆtheˆaccountˆholderˆinˆtheirˆownˆsigned-inˆsession.ˆ##ˆWhatˆthatˆmeansˆ-ˆWeˆcan'tˆdiscussˆanˆaccountˆwithˆaˆspouse,ˆpartner,ˆparent,ˆchildˆorˆfriend,ˆevenˆifˆtheyˆknowˆtheˆaccountˆdetails.ˆ-ˆWeˆcan'tˆmakeˆchangesˆbecauseˆsomeoneˆelseˆasks,ˆevenˆifˆthey'reˆmessagingˆfromˆtheˆaccountˆholder'sˆphone.ˆ-ˆWeˆcan'tˆconfirmˆwhetherˆaˆpersonˆhasˆaˆTallowbrookˆaccount.ˆ##ˆHelpingˆsomeoneˆwithˆtheirˆaccountˆTheˆaccountˆholderˆcanˆsitˆwithˆyouˆandˆmessageˆusˆfromˆtheirˆownˆsession.ˆWe'llˆtalkˆtoˆthemˆdirectly.ˆ##ˆLegalˆauthorityˆIfˆyouˆhaveˆpowerˆofˆattorney,ˆorˆyou'reˆhandlingˆtheˆaccountˆofˆsomeoneˆwhoˆhasˆdied,ˆweˆcanˆhelpˆthroughˆourˆAccountˆServicesˆteam.ˆSeeˆ"Powerˆofˆattorney"ˆandˆ"Ifˆanˆaccountˆholderˆhasˆdied".ˆ##ˆIfˆyouˆthinkˆsomeoneˆisˆmisusingˆyourˆaccountˆIfˆsomeoneˆelseˆisˆusingˆyourˆaccountˆwithoutˆyourˆpermission,ˆorˆpressuringˆyouˆoverˆyourˆmoney,ˆtellˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSeeˆ"Ifˆsomeoneˆisˆcontrollingˆyourˆmoney".ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
</documents>
